notes.title: Operation: Night Strikers Day, Aug 15th in Akihabara!
notes.content:
[h1][b]All units: converge on Akihabara![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/af01ee55df0eb91e34050fde7363d4add814e8a4.png"][/img][/p][p]On August 15, we’re holding a special [i]Night Striker[/i]-focused event above the Hey arcade in Akihabara, Tokyo. The venue will feature merchandise sales—including limited and early-release items—an actual arcade [i]Night Striker[/i] cabinet on display, and a hands-on play area.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/e54f20ba11e6f21d62b54eb07f881f11d58a936a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the morning, we’ll host the [b]“Night Striker Special Tactical Action Force Skills Trial in Hey”[/b] competition. Players will take on designated stages, competing for the highest Running Point score (displayed on the game’s gadget) at stage end. Entry is limited to 20 participants; if applications exceed this number, players will be selected at random. Those wishing to participate should register at the Hey 2F counter between [b]10:00 and 10:15[/b] on the day of the event.[/p][p][/p][p]At [b]15:00[/b], we present the [b]“Monthly ZUNTATA NIGHT – Special Summer 2025 Edition in Hey”[/b]. Guests will include M2 development staff from [i]Operation Night Strikers[/i] and [i]Night Striker GEAR[/i], showcasing live gameplay and delivering talks from the sound creators. The session will also be streamed live on YouTube—so if you can’t attend in person, join us online![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BqSo6EPjoL8"][/dynamiclink]([i]Stream available in Japanese only.[/i])[/p][p][/p][p]For full details, please check the event [url="https://www.taito.co.jp/event/001550"]announcement [/url]on the official TAITO website.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Night Strikers Day – Event Overview[/b]
[b]Date & Time:[/b] Friday, August 15, 2025 – 10:00–17:00 (JST)[/p][p][b]Venue:[/b] Events floor (5F) of Akihabara “Hey” Hirose HQ Building, 1–10–5 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo [i]Free Admission[/i][/p][p][b]“Monthly ZUNTATA NIGHT – Special Edition”[/b]
[b]Streaming Time:[/b] Friday, August 15, 2025 – 15:00–16:00 (planned)
[b]Streaming Platform:[/b] YouTube – “[url="https://www.youtube.com/ZUNTATACHANNEL"]ZUNTATA CHANNEL[/url]”
[b]Hosts:[/b] Katsuhisa Ishikawa (ZUNTATA), Yuichi Toyama (TAITO)
[b]Guests:[/b] Naoki Horii (M2), Hibana Yokeru (M2), Yukiharu Urita ([i]Night Striker GEAR[/i] composer)[/p][p][i]Doors open around 14:30. Admission may be restricted if the venue reaches capacity.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3099790/Operation_Night_Strikers/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290390/GEAR/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]"Operation Night Strikers" official site[/p][p][url="https://www.taito.co.jp/opstrikers"]https://www.taito.co.jp/opstrikers[/url][/p][p]"Night Strikers Gear" official site[/p][p][url="https://m2stg.com/night-striker-gear/"]https://m2stg.com/night-striker-gear/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Coming soon: TAITO SOUND BULLETS & Operation Night Strikers Book!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Take the Magazine, Secure the Tracks![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/af01ee55df0eb91e34050fde7363d4add814e8a4.png"][/img][/p][p]The booklet and soundtrack CD included with the Japanese console limited edition of [i]Operation Night Strikers[/i] are now available on Steam as digital content![/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Operation Night Strikers Book[/b] will be offered as DLC. Packed with rare photos of actual arcade cabinets and PCBs, it also covers console ports, merchandise, and other spin-off products. An exclusive interview with [i]Night Striker[/i] director Kenji Kaido (credited as Kenshi Kaito in Night Striker) and composer Masahiko Takaki is also included! ([i]Provided as a Japanese-language PDF[/i])[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/c6d52ea0faa99e9cf8b26c24a9df34c94eca3037.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/b1c11abfa8d71cbf339ee4fb1181a12600ebe4e8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/f5bd36b55c2f4f1a431e2234b4e6e4e1372a2042.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/a880b35d59e16d96db57a31f0fe7211c8cc5b0e6.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][b]TAITO SOUND BULLETS[/b] will be sold separately as a Steam Soundtrack. Experience authentic arcade sound from [i]Operation Wolf[/i], [i]Operation Thunderbolt[/i], and [i]Space Gun[/i], brought to life by the YM2151, YM2610, and MSM5205 sound chips. It also features brand-new compositions for [i]Operation Night Strikers[/i] and a new arrangement of [i]Space Gun[/i] by Norihiro “Nakayama Raiden” Furukawa, plus a new arrangement of [i]Night Striker[/i] by Yukiharu Urita!
([i]Provided in MP3 and FLAC formats[/i])[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/511c9e86c21a5349d37187b1272db1dcc16f7979.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Details available at the store pages, below![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837630/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837570/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Shooters Fes 2025: See Operation Night Strikers live!
notes.content: [h1]A hail of lead is heading to Tokyo![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/af01ee55df0eb91e34050fde7363d4add814e8a4.png"][/img][/p][p]Taito will be showing [b]Operation Night Strikers[/b] and [b]Night Strikers Gear[/b] during a live stream at Shooter Fes 2025, an online event focused on shooting games and organised by City Connection and Game Centre Mikado. The event runs over two days; June 14th and 15th with livestreams starting at 12:00 on each day.[/p][p][/p][p]The team from Taito will be on stream from [b]18:00 on Saturday 14th[/b], with producer Yuichi Toyama and Zuntata’s Katsuhisa Ishikawa being joined by guests Naoki Horii and Hibana Yokeru from developers M2. Learn all about the game play and sounds of Operation Night Strikers Night Strikers Gear while seeing the games in action and listening to the music. [/p][p][/p][p]The stream will run on Mikado’s YouTube channel and can be viewed live at Red Bull Gaming Sphere Tokyo.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/168062524f3dca88f4df5aaffa0ac15414765f96.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Shooter Fes 2025 [/p][p]Times/dates[/p][p] Day 1：Jun 14th 2025, 12:00 - 23:00 (JST)[/p][p] Day 2：Jun 15th 2025, 12:00 - 22:00 (JST)[/p][p][/p][p]Location[/p][p] Red Bull Gaming Sphere Tokyo ([url="https://www.google.com/maps/place/Red+Bull+Gaming+Sphere+Tokyo/data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x6018f293822141d7:0xbeff799abbf0b1a3"]Nakano, Tokyo[/url]) [/p][p] *Free entry[/p][p][/p][p]Streaming[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aG_Zcdqn6bY"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UuvA4VMYZQ0"][/dynamiclink] Channel: [url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPrifqgoJmq7UgmRkZUKTJQ"]https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPrifqgoJmq7UgmRkZUKTJQ[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Participants (in alphabetical order)[/p][p] Ancient [/p][p] BEEP[/p][p] CITY CONNECTION[/p][p] COMPILE HEART[/p][p] exA-Arcadia[/p][p] G-MODE[/p][p] Granzella [/p][p] G.rev[/p][p] Happinet[/p][p] Happymeal[/p][p] M2 Shot Triggers[/p][p] mebius.[/p][p] MIKADO[/p][p] MOSS[/p][p] Neotro[/p][p] Phoenixx[/p][p] Pyramid[/p][p] SUCCESS[/p][p] SUPERDELUXE GAMES[/p][p] TAITO[/p][p] TATSUJIN[/p][p][/p][p]Planning & Operation:[/p][p] CITY CONNECTION[/p][p] Gesen MIKADO(INH)[/p][p][/p][p]Cooperation:[/p][p] Happinet[/p][p][/p][p]Shooters Fes 2025[/p][p][url="https://shootersfes.com/"]https://shootersfes.com/[/url][/p][p]Operation Night Strikers[/p][p][url="https://www.taito.co.jp/opstrikers"]https://www.taito.co.jp/opstrikers[/url][/p][p]Nighe Striker GEAR[/p][p][url="https://m2stg.com/night-striker-gear/"]https://m2stg.com/night-striker-gear/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3099790/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290390/GEAR/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
